# Scope reference

<!-- Generated by `sidekick.export_reference`. Do not edit by hand. -->

## MCP scopes

The 13 scopes the public MCP surface can ever carry (`MCP_SCOPES`). A personal token holds the subset the operator names with `sidekick-admin create-token --scope`, an OAuth session the subset in `SIDEKICK_MCP_OAUTH_SCOPES`, and the stdio server every scope of the rooms that are switched on. No credential can hold more. The *Tools* column lists the tools that are refused without the scope (some need one of several scopes, such as `search`) and the tools it only widens; what each tool needs in full is in the [MCP tool reference](mcp/index.md).

- **Room**: the scopes of a room that `SIDEKICK_ENABLED_ROOMS` switches off are taken off the session, so the tools that look across rooms leave that room out.
- **Default**: no scope is implied. *Ordinary* scopes are granted when the token or policy names them; *opt-in* scopes (`OPT_IN_SCOPES`) are never part of an ordinary grant and must be named one by one.

| Scope | What it gives | Room | Default | Tools |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |

## Companion capabilities

Device capabilities of a paired companion app (ADR-005). They are not application scopes: no session, token or MCP credential can hold them, and a companion credential holds nothing else. Each one maps to a fixed set of operations (`sidekick.companion.operations`) that the companion routes call. Name them with `sidekick-companion pair|grant --scope` or a preset.

| Capability | What it gives | Operations | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `companion:journal:read` | read journal days and entries | `journal.day`, `journal.entries`, `journal.entry`, `journal.source`; also needed by `journal.entry_write`, `journal.entry_update` | off until named; in preset `app` |
| `companion:journal:write` | write and edit journal entries by hand (no AI) | `journal.entry_write`, `journal.entry_update` | off until named; in preset `app` |
| `companion:license` | see the license status and enter the instance’s license key (owner only) | `license.show`, `license.set` | off until named; in preset `app` |
| `companion:push` | receive notifications (register the phone’s push address) | `push.subscription`, `push.reminders` | off until named; in preset `app` |
| `companion:shopping:read` | read shopping lists and items | `shopping.lists`, `shopping.list`; also needed by `shopping.list_create`, `shopping.list_update`, `shopping.items_add`, `shopping.item_update`, `shopping.item_purchased` | off until named; in preset `app` |
| `companion:shopping:write` | add, edit, and check off items and lists | `shopping.list_create`, `shopping.list_update`, `shopping.items_add`, `shopping.item_update`, `shopping.item_purchased` | off until named; in preset `app` |
| `companion:tasks:complete` | check off and reopen tasks and steps | `task.complete`, `task.reopen`, `step.complete`, `step.reopen` | off until named; in preset `app` |
| `companion:tasks:read` | read tasks, steps, projects, and today’s agenda | `work.agenda`, `work.today`, `task.get`, `task.steps`, `task.contacts`, `task.external_references`, `work.hierarchy`, `project.get`, `project.tasks`, `domain.get`, `process.get` | off until named; in preset `app` |
